name: large_baseline
description: Baseline with large reasoning model (Qwen3-Next 80B). No debate strategy overrides.

name: large_dialectical
description: Dialectical debate for structural phases with large reasoning model. Tests whether structured disagreement adds value when model can already reason.

name: large_socratic
description: Socratic questioning for conceptual phases with large model. Tests whether explicit probing helps a model that can already self-reflect.

name: large_mixed
description: Best-of-each strategy per phase with large reasoning model. Tests whether per-phase optimization stacks with reasoning ability.

name: large_llm_only
description: LLM-only baseline with large model. Direct single-shot prompting without multi-agent debate. Matches naive approaches in related work.
